title: ID0397698-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N0 170000002] LocalPreAuthorize
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Customer is claiming that as per the OCPP Protocol the EVC must support sending TagID in case of free vend mode.
Root cause: Configuration keys was not enabled.
Solution: Set recommended Configure keys.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Not active

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0397698-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N0 170000002] LocalPreAuthorize CRM:00921001445
additional_info.body:
Dear Beerpal,
Thanks for your email.
Kindly be informed that;
1-In free vend mode; Customer is claiming that sending Dummy Token (i.e.: IDTag:"") is not as per the OCPP standard and the EVC must send an IDTag to the backend not Dummy one.
2
-Customer needs the below setting to be enabled/true as it showing false ""key":"LocalPreAuthorize","value":"false","readonly":false", so please advise if the same is related to the authorization key in the SCB or it is a command to be sent from the OCPP? , if it is a command, please share the address for the same.
Kindly be informed that this ticket has been initially assigned as technical inquiry not incident.
BR,
Sadek

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0397698-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N0 170000002] LocalPreAuthorize CRM:00921001445
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Thanks for the response.
When checked the charger logs, we found that local authorization is not enabled on this charger.
The backend needs to set all the highlighted parameters to "True" and then send the list of all whitelisted RFID IDs through the backend. The maximum supported length for the list is 100.
This is why authorization did not occur when the charger was offline.
Please let us know if this backend has already been integrated with Sicharge D. If it has not, backend integration will be required for further troubleshooting.
Additionally, please note that the charger is now out of warranty.
For more details, please refer to the KA via the following
link
.
Let us know if you have any other questions, or if we can proceed with closing this ticket.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
